fsd_text: It replaces the OBIEE dashboard page "Sample Sales / Overview".
Each manager should see only their own offices; the Head of Sales sees everything.
Year: Calendar year of the order
Office: The sales office
Product brand: Brand of the product sold
Region: Sales region the office belongs to
Net revenue: Revenue after discounts, for the filtered period
Units sold: Number of units sold
Revenue vs target: Net revenue as a percentage of the revenue target for the same period
Average selling price: Net revenue divided by units sold
Active customers: Number of distinct customers who placed at least one order in the period
